blocks.text: Forest Glen homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Forest Glen, September 2026. Detached houses: 18 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 64 listed at month end and 6 sold in September, a sales ratio of 9% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 6 sold over 4 months against an average of 18.0 listed, about 12.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 2 sold. Condos and townhomes: 34 sold over 4 months against an average of 54.0 listed, about 6.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 16 sold.

items.t: Forest Glen condos and townhomes for sale

faq.q: Is Forest Glen mostly houses or condos?
faq.a: Both, with condos ahead: in September 2026 the row showed 64 condos and townhomes listed and 6 sold, against 18 detached listings and 1 detached sale — the attached stock on and off Kingsway outweighs the house streets in listings (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which schools serve a Forest Glen address?
faq.a: It depends on the address. SD41 schools in or beside the area include Clinton Elementary (K–7), 5858 Clinton St, École Inman Elementary (K–7), 3963 Brandon St, Nelson Elementary (K–7), 4850 Irmin St, and Burnaby South Secondary (8–12), 5455 Rumble St; catchments are address-based and must be checked in the SD41 locator.

faq.q: How is transit in Forest Glen?
faq.a: Strong for a house neighbourhood: Metrotown and Patterson Expo Line stations are at the west side, and route 110 runs on Bond and Nelson streets themselves, linking Metrotown Station to Sperling and Lougheed stations via Willingdon, Deer Lake Parkway, Winston and Government Road.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Forest Glen?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 18 houses listed with 1 sold in the month and 64 condos and townhomes listed with 6 sold in the month in Forest Glen. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Forest Glen a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 6%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 9%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
